svg.title: Air quality technician — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as air quality technician, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: An air-sampling unit has a tall inlet mast and round indicator beside a separate two-stage filter cartridge. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face.
